description: This Java source file implements a logging utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It includes methods for chaining log nodes and offers a wrapper around Android's native Log class for consistent logging across an application.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels and managing LogNode objects for log chaining.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode used for logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log entries will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (critical error) message with optional Throwable.
